purpose: Teach: 知識人/会派/替わり/積ま/計っ/常用/手作業/シード

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、知識人の証言も、参考にしております。
lines.en: We've also taken statements from community members who know the situation well.
lines.style: Even, measured tone. Professional but not cold. Slight pause after the opening phrase, as if documenting as he speaks. Clear enunciation, steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の自治会派、警察と協力体制、できています。
lines.en: Yes. The neighborhood association and police have a good working relationship already.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Steady, collaborative tone. Not rushed—each phrase given its due. Slight lift at the end, showing readiness to cooperate further.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 担当官の替わりに、私が、ご説明します。
lines.en: The assigned officer is unavailable, so I'll walk you through the details.
lines.style: Respectful and reassuring. Light emphasis on 'I'—taking responsibility without ceremony. Warm but official. The voice of someone stepping in with competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害品、倉庫に、積まれていた状態でした。
lines.en: Understood. The stolen items were stacked in the warehouse when we discovered them.
lines.style: Factual, direct delivery. Slight pause between each element—giving Officer Takeda time to document. No emotion, just clear information. Quiet confidence in the details.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害金額、しっかり計って、報告書、提出します。
lines.en: We'll calculate the total loss carefully and submit a full report.
lines.style: Methodical and precise. Light stress on 'carefully'—showing diligence. Deliberate pacing, like checking items off a list. Professional commitment without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用車、常用している運転手、確認しました。
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed the driver who uses the company vehicle regularly.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Brief pause after 'driver'—letting the important detail land. No hesitation, suggesting thorough verification already done. Cooperative tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠検証、手作業で、慎重にやらせていただいています。
lines.en: We're examining the evidence by hand, taking our time to be thorough.
lines.style: Careful, almost deliberate pace. Slight emphasis on 'by hand'—reassuring precision. Respectful tone, showing the care being taken. Voice level steady and assured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規防犯活動の、シード資金、ご相談したいです。
lines.en: Thank you. I'd like to discuss funding for some new neighborhood crime prevention initiatives.
lines.style: Respectful shift in tone—moving from report-giving to request. Slightly tentative, but not uncertain. A pause before 'funding,' showing this matters. Earnest and direct.
